therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation and anti-tumor immune response

biomarker_changes: PD-L1 positive patients (≥5%) showed greater benefit: median OS 53.36 months vs 12.39 months (HR 0.37)
PD-L1 negative patients also benefited: median OS 26.97 months vs 10.84 months (HR 0.60)
subgroup_findings: PD-L1 positive patients had superior outcomes compared to PD-L1 negative patients
Durable responses observed with 36.2% of nivolumab patients alive at 84 months vs 16.9% with dacarbazine
